response.justification: Despite extensive software engineering experience, the candidate lacks demonstrable C++ expertise beyond a brief early-career role at National Instruments, with no evidence of modern C++/STL, multi-threading, message brokers, IEC 62443, or industrial automation systems — all core requirements for this role. Their recent work is overwhelmingly in TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang, with no cloud platform or IoT protocol experience relevant to the position.
strengths: Strong full-stack and cross-platform development experience
Demonstrated open-source contributions and technical leadership
Excellent communication and mentoring background through workshops
concerns: Minimal recent C++ experience; core competency mismatch
No exposure to industrial cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443) or MQTT/Modbus
Lacks cloud platform (Azure) or industrial automation domain background
